exposure: approaches to vaginal breech deliveries during 2007-2012
approaches to vaginal breech deliveries during 2013-2022
outcome: success rate for planned vaginal breech deliveries
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing vaginal breech deliveries for term breech presentation at a single tertiary center between 2007-2012 and 2013-2022.
finding: The vaginal breech delivery rate increased from 8% to 10% across the two study periods, but the success rate for planned vaginal breech deliveries decreased from 62% to 53%.
mod_finding: The vaginal breech delivery rate increased from 8% (2007-2012) to 10% (2013-2022), while the success rate for planned vaginal breech deliveries decreased from 62% to 53%.
